User Story: As an Operations Analyst, I want a consolidated reconciliation overview so that I can understand the current workload.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a selected time window, when the overview loads, then summary counts reflect records in that window.
Given the source job failed, when the view opens, then the latest run status and last successful timestamp are visible.
Given the user can access only a subset of records, when metrics are displayed, then they respect the same access scope.

User Story: As an Operations Analyst, I want to search a payment by reference so that I can investigate a specific customer report.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a valid payment ID or reference, when I search, then matching permitted records are returned.
Given no match exists, when the search completes, then a clear empty state appears.
Given a malformed query, when submitted, then the input is handled safely without exposing a stack trace.

User Story: As an Operations Analyst, I want to compare internal and gateway fields so that I can understand the reconciliation outcome.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a transaction has both source values, when details are opened, then amount, currency, reference and status are shown side by side.
Given a mismatch exists, then the reason code and compared values are visible.
Given source data is missing, then the UI shows “Unavailable” rather than substituting a guessed value.

User Story: As an Operations Analyst, I want exceptions created for unmatched records so that work is not lost in manual trackers.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an eligible unmatched transaction, when the reconciliation run completes, then an exception case exists with a reason code.
Given the same event is replayed, then no duplicate open case is created for the configured uniqueness key.
Given a match becomes valid after a new event, then the case follows the approved status transition rule.

User Story: As an Operations Analyst, I want to assign and comment on a case so that work has a clear owner and investigation history.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have assignment permission, when I assign an eligible owner, then case ownership updates and an audit event is recorded.
Given I add a note, when it is saved, then the note appears with actor and timestamp.
Given I lack permission, when I attempt either action, then the server rejects it and the record remains unchanged.

User Story: As an authorised user, I want to resolve a case with a reason so that the outcome is clear and auditable.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given required resolution type or reason is missing, when I submit, then field validation prevents submission.
Given the role is authorised and policy does not require approval, when I submit a valid resolution, then the case status becomes Resolved and an audit record is added.
Given approval is required, when I submit, then the case moves to Pending Approval and does not become Resolved until approval.

User Story: As an Operations Lead, I want to review and approve escalated resolutions so that controlled actions follow policy.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a case requires approval, when an authorised lead opens it, then requested action and supporting reason are visible.
Given approval is granted or rejected, when a decision is saved, then actor, timestamp and decision are recorded.
Given the same decision is submitted twice, then duplicate transitions are prevented.

User Story: As a Support user, I want read-only transaction status so that I can answer operational questions without changing records.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a Read-only role, when transaction details are opened, then permitted fields are visible.
Given a read-only user attempts to resolve, assign or edit, then the action is unavailable in the UI and denied by the server.
Given sensitive fields are restricted, then they are omitted or masked according to policy.

User Story: As an Operations Analyst, I want to filter the exception queue so that I can work the most urgent cases first.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given status, reason, owner and date filters, when applied, then results satisfy all selected filters.
Given a filter returns no cases, then the page presents an empty state and a way to clear filters.
Given filters are changed, then count and displayed rows remain consistent.

User Story: As a Platform Operator, I want ingestion and reconciliation job status so that I can detect source-feed issues.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a job completed, then status and last-run time are displayed.
Given a job failed, then a safe error summary and next action are shown.
Given a retry is initiated, then duplicate processing is prevented by idempotency controls.
